text:
samir: FYI received a support ticket from Acme Health — their Jan usage invoice shows missing line items for embeddings and also a duplicate invoice for the same billing period. Ticket attached: #BILL-7890.
zoe: ugh. can you paste the two invoice ids?
samir: INV-2025-3344 and INV-2025-3344-1 (customer sees both). They say the amounts differ by $0.03 on the total and embedding lines are absent on the first one.
billing-bot: Reconciliation job rec-87211 completed at 2025-01-15T08:02:11Z. Mismatches detected: 1 invoice duplicate, 2 missing line items.
maya: Looking at invoice metadata — duplicate was created at 2025-01-12T23:59:58Z by invoice-generator v2.3.3 in retry path. It looks like the original had a partial failure before line item flush.
eli: logging from generator:  
```
2025-01-12T23:59:58Z ERROR invoice_generator.worker: flush_partial_invoice failed: TimeoutError
2025-01-12T23:59:58Z INFO invoice_generator.worker: retrying invoice create (request_id=null)
2025-01-12T23:59:59Z INFO invoice_generator.worker: created invoice INV-2025-3344-1 (no line_items)
```
eli: repro suggests when request_id is null we don't dedupe on idempotency key — bug. I can patch to use customer+period checksum as fallback.
zoe: Customer is asking for urgent correction and refund for the duplicate. They flagged it with finance ops and customer success. Any quick fix?
harper: Approve urgent fix: cancel INV-2025-3344-1 and issue a credit for the duplicate amount. Approve refund up to $5k. Please document in the ticket.
maya: Running ad-hoc remediate: `python tools/invoice_fix.py --invoice INV-2025-3344-1 --action credit --reason "duplicate due to retry"`  Starting now.
maya: done — credit issued (CRD-1024) for $2,340.77 and duplicate invoice voided. Updated ticket #BILL-7890 with refund id.
samir: Thx. Can eng also push a hotfix for the dedupe fallback? We should avoid manual fixes.
eli: I'll open PR with fallback idempotency using sha256(customer_id+period+sequence) and add unit + integration test. Targeting hotfix release today. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/invoice-generator/pull/412
zoe: Please add a note to billing run playbook for manual checklist: (1) search for invoices with same billed_period+customer within 2 minutes, (2) check for missing line_items, (3) run invoice_fix.
harper: Finance confirmed refund and emailed Acme Health. Also schedule a reconciliation run after hotfix to catch any similar duplicates.
samir: closing loop — ticket updated, customer notified, eng hotfix in progress, postmortem request filed (BILL-7890-PM). tagging @eng-runtime for follow-up. :thumbsup:
